page: Microsoft Azure E20ps_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the 64-bit ARM architecture. It features 20 dedicated physical cores based on the Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.0 GHz, with 1 thread per core. The instance is provisioned with 160.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. CPU cache architecture includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Cryptographic processing includes hardware-accelerated AES instructions, though x86-specific vector extensions such as AVX and AMX are not present.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent average throughput across multi-threaded computational and memory workloads. The instance achieved 36,041.2 in multi-core stress-ng tests and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,292. Memory subsystem performance is characterized by an uncached read bandwidth of 131.23 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 71.51 GB/sec. In key-value and data operations, it recorded 27.33 million Redis SET operations per second and a PassMark database operations score of 13,196.44. However, single-threaded processing reflects architectural tradeoffs, with Geekbench single-core scoring 1,100.0 and single-threaded bzip3 decompression falling into the lower quartile.

The E20ps_v5 includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached remote storage volumes for persistent data storage. The absence of hardware GPU accelerators and moderate single-core throughput make it less suited for high-parameter machine learning inference or instruction-serial tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per core on an ARM-based architecture provides an economical alternative to traditional x86 memory-heavy instances.

This server type is primarily structured for workloads requiring significant memory capacity alongside parallel execution, such as in-memory caching systems, distributed data caches, enterprise relational databases, large-scale Redis deployments, and memory-intensive microservices.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ps_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the 64-bit ARMv8 architecture, running on an Ampere Neoverse-N1 processor clocked at 3.0 GHz. It delivers 20 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading and is paired with 160.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per core distribution. The instance does not bundle local storage, operating as a diskless node reliant on external block volumes, and includes no GPU hardware. In synthetic benchmarks, the instance yields average multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics, reaching 27.33 million Redis SET operations per second and a multi-core stress-ng score of 36,041.2, while single-core execution remains relatively modest. Providing high RAM density on an energy-efficient ARM platform, the E20ps_v5 is tailored for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, memory-intensive backend microservices, and general scale-out enterprise workloads requiring high memory capacity.
